package.name: skill_manager
package.description: Skill-level gateway between operators and the YARR robot HTTP API. A single tkinter window exposes five skills (pick, pyramid, update_input, recover, scan); the active skill radio gates which panel is interactive, so only one skill can be invoked at a time. Each skill validates ROS-side state (standing/fallen cup tracks, slot vacancy, verifier cp/degree) before POSTing to the API.
